entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, a self-hosted server, and a cloud platform.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides agent memory workflows built around retaining, recalling, and reflecting on information. It supports hosted and local LLM providers and can be deployed with Docker, pip, or Kubernetes.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes resources, memories, and skills as files. It supports scoped semantic search, tiered L0/L1/L2 loading via viking:// URIs, and session archives with inspectable Markdown memories.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is an open-source platform for persistent agent memory across sessions, using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It structures text into entities, relationships, and searchable chunks, and supports custom data models, ontologies, plugins, and MCP connections.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts conversation facts and handles contradictions and automatic forgetting. It also connects to services including Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and processes PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. Memory can be shared across agents while transient task state stays local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peers, sessions, and messages over time. It offers Python and TypeScript SDKs and supports managed, local, and self-hosted use.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repository, providing version control for a context tree made of plain Markdown. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider with five-tier retrieval, an interactive TUI and REPL, and support for 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes Agents, described as zero-dependency and sub-millisecond. It has one pure-Python dependency and integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; BEAM results are reported for v3.0.0, while LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciling conflicting information and managing forgetting. It also supports memory exchange through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: memory-os is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines vector search with structured facts. It uses local infrastructure with Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and applies a Ground Truth hierarchy so the agent prioritizes injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: autocontext is a recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks. Runs can start from a plain-language goal or saved scenario, and their filesystem-based artifacts can be inspected, diffed, replayed, or exported.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Déjà vu indexes and searches session history across 43 agents, including months of past conversations already stored on disk. It offers terminal search, session resume, and cross-agent handoff, and runs locally without a model or server.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes LCM is a Hermes Agent plugin that uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages without losing them. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho Self-Hosted provides Hermes Agent with private memory that persists across sessions. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, with an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: SignetAI provides a local-first layer for agent identity, memory, and secrets, with portable state across Hermes Agent and other agent harnesses. It connects through hooks, plugins, or extensions and offers a dashboard for browsing memory and asking questions; it can run locally or as a team server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memories as plain YAML files in an open engram format. It includes local search with keyword search as a fallback, plus CLI setup and an MCP server.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, integrating through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based long-term memory stored locally in a SQLite file, with FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, including text and multimodal contexts. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, with integrations including Hermes Agent, vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: YantrikDB is a self-maintaining Hermes memory plugin whose recall results include a why_retrieved explanation. It uses an embedded backend by default, also offers an HTTP backend, and includes contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides long-term, cross-project memory for coding agents, with inspectable Markdown files and frontmatter metadata as the source of truth. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, while MCP servers and host-specific plugins connect it to agents.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI that recalls, maintains, and evolves persistent knowledge across sessions. It builds a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate QMD uses anticipatory caching to prefetch context by watching agent session logs. This local-first memory project uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack combines Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace under a single memory owner, using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval. It prepares a purpose-built evidence packet for the agent on each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, then combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal. Its edge tags link stored notes bidirectionally, making it a reflective memory option for agents.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19+, and includes a dashboard for savings and tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals, with integrations that are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes plugin stores memory in a single embedded .lbdb graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search with named relationships between entries. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability indexing and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three Hermes hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports immediate event deletion and uses an on-demand summarizer. It also records prefetch operations in a trace.jsonl audit log.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers a session’s original goal from its first user turn, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This Hermes plugin communicates with XMemo over HTTPS to provide durable cross-session memory with semantic search. It offers ranked, bounded context recall before a turn and includes a local SQLite reliability layer.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. It supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, with slash commands for search, context, and Q&A plus repo sync and indexed git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It supports native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution and combines HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor, sparse, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides memory-management and knowledge-graph traversal through 17 tools for Hermes Agent. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit curates agent memory stored in plain Markdown files, proposing evidence-cited JSON diffs for review rather than using a database. Its rot and lint curators identify stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software-development methodology whose skills trigger automatically in supported coding-agent harnesses. Its workflow covers specification, planning, and subagent-driven development, and its README provides installation instructions for multiple coding agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first design and prototyping system with CLI support for coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports interactive web prototypes with live previews, slide decks, images, and motion graphics, alongside skills, templates, design systems, and plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project offers structured cybersecurity skills spanning security domains, with mappings to MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its README describes compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and the project includes a diagramctl CLI with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court provides a master router and connector skills, with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It also adds a verification and dispute-resolution layer for agent-to-agent commerce.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing detects patterns in files or piped text and can rewrite content with up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing mode refuses to modify source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw integrates with Hermes, Codex, Claude Code, and other agents to unify skills across agents and devices. A dashboard supports skills, validation, versions, and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills. It supports Claude Code, Codex, and agent-plugins.org specifications, and maintains session state in the project’s docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This project provides professional agent skills with frameworks, output templates, quality checks, and anti-patterns; the README describes 21 skills designed for unattended use. Install via `npx pm-claude-skills add` or Claude Code’s plugin directory, with skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube Skills provides skills for transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It supports Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key with a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super Hermes generates custom analytical instructions for specific tasks and includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote skill registries from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and scripts, including sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates literate documents that combine prose, diagrams, and code, then extracts runnable source files from them. When those source files change, it syncs the edits back to the literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates documents with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents with structured memory, cross-feature learning, and a plan-approve-execute workflow. It requires no background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, plus CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Supports shared memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, alongside guides to installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. The community accepts contributions through pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting guidance and API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills specification, with installation available through npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agentskills.io-compliant agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It supports automated and step-by-step workflows, with tools for skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika checks workflows before calling a model, then runs them with a chosen model locally or through a provider API. It records runs in a hash-chained trace.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a Python SkilldockClient and CLI for a registry of reusable skills based on the AgentSkills specification. Skill installation supports recursive dependency resolution, and the registry includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a recovery path.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and operates autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skill list before LLM calls to reduce token usage, using five retrieval layers that include hard triggers and semantic embeddings. It can gracefully degrade when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs read-only, adversarial code reviews with parallel subagents focused on edge cases, adversarial review, and integration analysis. It combines a deterministic pre-scan with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system where habits recur and are scored daily, while tasks cover other activities. It runs locally with SQLite storage, includes an Android client, and connects to agents over MCP.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This code simplification skill assigns parallel agents to Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness, supporting TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. Its tiered application process includes an approval gate.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab brings together 2,077 skills across multiple repositories and installs more than 131 tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, MISP, CVSS, EPSS, OWASP, NIST, Sigma, and YARA.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition, requiring evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.doomsday-network/bounty-guard: Bounty Guard scans untrusted GitHub issues and repositories for prompt injection and repository threat signals, classifying issues as SAFE_WITH_ESCROW, SAFE_NO_ESCROW, or QUARANTINE. This zero-dependency Python project also provides MCP tools for escrow verification.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Skillsdotnet implements agentskills.io in C#/.NET with MCP integration, loading skills progressively through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, read-only observability dashboard with real-time tracking of token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It also supports local log desensitization and optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain-markdown skills for session management, multi-session reconciliation, worktree recovery, code review, and skill scaffolding. It belongs on this list for its practical workflows and simple installation by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs, generating vhs or Playwright recording scripts and optimizing GIFs to target sizes under 8 MB. It supports demos of terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries.
entries.doomsday-network/web3-agent-skills: This pack provides configurations for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Cline, alongside commands for scanning bounty issues and mining pool shares. Its remote MCP server adds escrow and pool leaderboard tools, giving it a focus on Web3 bounty and mining workflows.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This skill generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches RemoteOpenClaw for more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, and provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. It integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project analyzes past sessions and installed skills to draft structured improvement proposals, with proposals review-only by default. Its evaluation gate supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators before changes are applied.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage packages skills for social platforms and web data, along with skills for complete jobs. It supports installation through SKILL.md-compatible clients.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using the path syntax for the current environment and select and verify existing, project-compatible Python interpreters. They support native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection transcribes Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, removes common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracts structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. Its tools cover video transcription, text editing, and document OCR.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents list open support bounties, buy ticket context, and submit answers for human review; public wallet earnings records are also available. Board creation returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.f-o-x11/deed-page-skill: This agent skill publishes files to a permanent deed.page URL with one curl request and no account. The README provides installation options for several agents and describes an MCP server at https://deed.page/mcp.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests AI agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It belongs in a skills list as a way to assess whether a skill works and provide an Ed25519-signed certificate that can be verified through its public API.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, exposing 191 tools. It also includes five ready-to-use workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: AlphaPipeline offers risk checks for token honeypots, taxes, and liquidity, along with market data such as DEX slippage and funding rates. Its REST endpoints and remote MCP server make those checks and data available to AI agents.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This repository provides a KissCode skill for agents that read SKILL.md, with installation instructions for several agent environments. It belongs in this list as an agent-ready route to joining KissCode, and mirrors kisscode.ai/skill.md.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: China Briefing generates Chinese news reports at multiple geographic scales, from global to street level. Its structured reports include conclusions and action suggestions, and it uses semantic memory of user interests to expand searches.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: Astro Agents MCP provides a no-auth MCP endpoint for deterministic Western and Vedic astrology results, with SHA-256 hashes for verification. It also supports per-call REST payment via x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage, with incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas. Its socket-based daemon architecture keeps connections persistent, making it a distinctive fit for Hermes Agent skills that need to access MCP servers efficiently.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This Nix project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, and automatically updates its packages daily. Its README provides `nix run` commands for the listed tools, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. It also documents OpenClaw setup and access to device hardware and UI through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android, using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models through Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It offers direct and CRD-based deployment workflows, plus configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, and scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image with mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module supports declarative Hermes deployment, including configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills and supports secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes-OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a headless, reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This project provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation options via an OCI registry or a published Helm repository. Provider-specific values examples and CI installation on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a deployment option with documented configuration examples and a Kubernetes install check.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to agents in specialized roles and has them discuss strategies dynamically. It is designed for research purposes.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted system for governing agent tasks, registrations, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It stands out for offering Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces, with a web dashboard for structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support delegation and handoffs, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts provide a way to represent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It combines a Kanban board and live streams of agent reasoning and tool execution with human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for coordinating Leader and Specialist agents through an automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tools and communication, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code and orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It also provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents operate across two competing AI companies. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, it displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local Mixture-of-Agents framework that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and does not require cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local project graph with `codegraph init`, then keeps it in sync as files change. Its MCP server connects that pre-indexed code knowledge to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, with the stated goal of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage and costs across Hermes and a range of other AI coding agents. It offers both a CLI and a visualization dashboard for reviewing that usage.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor is a real-time widget for tracking token usage, costs, and rate limits across 47+ AI coding tools. It also shows usage trends and breakdowns across tools and devices, with multi-device sync.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap records and displays coding-agent API traces, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. It can compare adjacent requests to show context changes and redacts common authentication headers before recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design skills, UI prompts, and layout guidance for building interfaces with AI. It supports providers that accept Markdown or general prompting and connects to coding tools through its MCP server or plugins.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an installable workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes product-development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop with seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI collection of themes for the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create skins with YAML files; custom skins inherit unspecified values from the default skin.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks agent-facing content in project directories, including agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. Its findings include file locations and suggested fixes, and it supports CI gates and reviewed baselines.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place supports encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable @handles. It also facilitates commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without a separate process or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for CLI workflows, with the project highlighting 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating Hermes agents scoped to individual folders, with local configuration, skills, memories, tools, and instructions. It switches between the default and scoped agents, making it useful for keeping project-specific agent setups separate.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool moves OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats, and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.doomsday-network/github-bounty-scanner: This scanner searches GitHub issues for bounty labels or mentions of USDC, wDOOM, or Algora, then classifies matches into three safety categories. Its quickstart runs `scan_bounties.py` with Python 3.
entries.doomsday-network/cuda-gpu-miner: This project provides a standalone pool miner that runs with Python and documents CUDA GPU mining. Its deployment instructions cover Docker, RunPod, and Vast.ai.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco monitors AI agents with a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations. It offers zero-token passive analysis and scheduled active probing, and uses local file changes to help detect performance drift.
entries.doomsday-network/doom-pay: DoomPay provides HTML checkout and hosted checkout sessions for DOOM on Layer-1 and wDOOM on Base Mainnet. It also includes a Python SDK and MCP payment verification.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent and runs offline without API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup is a local runtime for using Hermes Agent to pursue online opportunities, operating deterministically with zero network access by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: hermes-memoss is a Hermes memory plugin with semantic search and multidimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC-Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with 21 built-in professional assistants. It also supports remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms, and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides web and phone access to Hermes Agent, with a three-panel layout for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its workspace file browser includes inline previews, and the project is designed for access through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools; the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for Hermes Agent that brings together chats, sessions, agent integrations, usage analytics, scheduled jobs, and channel configuration. It also offers visual workflows with schedules and approval gates, and is available as a desktop app, npm CLI, and Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace is a native web workspace combining chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector panel. Its highlights include Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate across agents, or queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH, using real session data and an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS and native window and process management. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health-check and update capabilities, alongside interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime, including Hermes Cloud and self-hosted connections. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports streamed chats and file or image attachments, and lets users browse, search, and resume server sessions and view scheduled tasks, skills, memory, and insights.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It tracks agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and includes a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs. It lets users search local histories for prompts, tool calls, errors, and file paths, inspect session metadata and supported token or pricing details, and keeps session histories from being uploaded.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted, browser-based dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, with tools including a terminal, file explorer, session overview, and cron management. Its real-time chat visualizes tool calls, while its MCP control plane and ZOO Swarm Monitor support server lifecycle management and agent health and kanban tracking.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to a web dashboard through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox is for requests with side effects; the project is built with Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS v4.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI that connects to the Hermes Agent gateway. Its tabs cover profiles, sessions, skills, cron, and memory, alongside kanban boards, task details, diagnostics, and dispatch controls.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally run, 10-page mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It includes terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes Agent as a Windows desktop app with a dark-themed, multilingual GUI and session management. Its highlights include workflow automation, runtime tool creation, and local-model support through LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a glassmorphic web interface for a self-hosted Hermes Agent, with chat and real-time log streaming. It also brings together a file browser, task tracking, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a process-monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time session activity and cost tracking, inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, and read-only views of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: PAN-UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It also offers a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent collaboration, with streaming SSE responses and model switching. It features an orchestrator coordinating 20 specialized AI agents and a visual Skill Store with 50+ curated one-click installations.
entries.nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher: This plugin for the Hermes Agent Web Dashboard shows configured routes across profiles in one matrix, so you can compare them in one place. It previews changes before applying them and includes named presets and a guarded Undo.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: This unofficial, open-source chat client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent supports interactive answers such as checklists, choices, forms, rankings, and votes. It also provides command approvals and live tool-step updates, and runs on Android, web, and macOS, with Linux in alpha.
